title.zh: 修订第920号共和国法中关于甲米地省公共工程项目的某些项目的法案
title.en: An Act to Amend Certain Items of Republic Act Numbered Nine Hundred Twenty, Regarding Public Works Projects for the Province of Cavite
title.orig: An Act to Amend Certain Items of Republic Act Numbered Nine Hundred Twenty, Regarding Public Works Projects for the Province of Cavite
title.vi: Đạo luật sửa đổi Đạo luật Cộng hòa số 920
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแก้ไขเพิ่มเติมพระราชบัญญัติแห่งสาธารณรัฐที่ 920

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1954/ra_994_1954.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
Item three, Group I, paragraph (b), Title B, section one of Republic Act Numbered Nine hundred twenty, regarding public works for the Province of Cavite, is amended to read as follows:
"(3) Andres Bonifacio Memorial Hospital, Quintana or site of proposed provincial capital, Cavite ₱150,000.00"

Item (j), Group II, paragraph (a), Title C, section one of the same Act, regarding public works for the same province, is amended to read as follows:
"(j) Naic-Sahing-Dasmariñas via Quintana Road ₱80,000.00"

Item sixteen (g), Group II, paragraph (a), Title E, section one of the same Act, regarding public works for the same province, is amended to read as follows:
"(g) Bacoor public market building, including purchase of site ₱40,000.00"

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 8, 1954.
